copy.tagline: 创建、编辑和验证技能，确保部署前正常工作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要创建或维护自己的技能
copy.tagline_en: Create, edit, and verify skills before deployment
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create or maintain your own skills

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照测试驱动开发（TDD）的方法来创建和编辑技能文档。它会先编写测试用例，观察代理在没有技能时的失败行为，然后编写技能文档，再验证代理是否遵守，最后优化文档。
howto.when: 当用户需要创建新技能、编辑现有技能或在部署前验证技能是否正常工作时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新技能，用于处理异步测试中的竞态条件。
say.note: Claude 会按照 TDD 流程创建技能文档。

say.text: 检查我现有的技能“condition-based-waiting”是否需要更新。
say.note: Claude 会运行测试并建议修改。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will create and edit skill documents using a test-driven development approach. It writes test cases, observes agent failures without the skill, writes the skill, verifies compliance, and refines the documentation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when creating new skills, editing existing skills, or verifying skills work before deployment.

say_en.text: Create a new skill for handling race conditions in async tests.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the TDD process to create the skill.

say_en.text: Check if my existing skill 'condition-based-waiting' needs updates.
say_en.note: Claude will run tests and suggest modifications.
